problem.title: L-LO on KITTI Odom seq 07 full: registration sweep
problem.question: Which registration (step size, similarity weights, termination) setting gives the lowest error on seq 07? Seq 07 is the only sequence used for choosing parameters; 00/02/05/08 stay held out.

variants.label: step half
variants.intent: One-factor change from the repository defaults: step_coeff_translation=0.001, step_coeff_rotation=0.0001

variants.label: step double
variants.intent: One-factor change from the repository defaults: step_coeff_translation=0.004, step_coeff_rotation=0.0004

variants.label: shape 0p8
variants.intent: One-factor change from the repository defaults: similarity_weight_shape=0.8, similarity_weight_size=0.2

variants.label: shape 0p2
variants.intent: One-factor change from the repository defaults: similarity_weight_shape=0.2, similarity_weight_size=0.8

variants.label: rounds 600 tol 1e5
variants.intent: One-factor change from the repository defaults: max_rounds=600, termination=1e-5
